about.label: 04 — ABOUT
about.pullQuote: I build the boring parts well so the interesting parts get a chance.
about.body:
I'm a software engineer with ten years of experience in the Laravel ecosystem (TALL & VILT) and, more recently, Next.js and Astro. I specialize in multi-tenant applications, Filament admin panels, serious API integrations (Google Workspace, QuickBooks, Hotmart, MikroTik, n8n) and programmatic SEO at scale.

Most of my current work is legacy modernization: decomposing oversized Livewire components, moving business logic out of views and into controllers, and reshaping what is left into prop-driven boundaries — the form a Vue component takes — so the refactor becomes the path toward Inertia rather than a detour before it.

I've worked with US companies (Level60 Consulting · Nashville, EyeUniversal · San José) and led the technical team at Ovy.so for five years, migrating a PHP monolith to Laravel and then to Inertia — v1 through v2, Vue 2 through Vue 3 — building a PWA, and shipping a Google Workspace integration.

Now I split my time between client contracts and shipping my own products (Ultti, Malta Pharmacy Empire, mkdn). I use Claude Code and Cursor as part of my daily workflow — they're tools, not authors.

Available for remote contracts, Laravel performance audits, and product collaborations.
